summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE index (segment NIDX): the index packet carries the prices only.

notes: Frames follow the INDstocks price socket's documented shape (indmoney_adapter.py:575-583: mode, instrument, timestamp in ms, data) with fractional prices so a price's JSON type is not what differs.

deviations.reason: Follows the broker's web adapter; set in the per-broker dialect entry (lane wire) in Phase B. The desktop sends the label (ltp, quote); INDmoney's web adapter sends the subscription's mode number (indmoney_adapter.py:611).

The web sends the packet's own millisecond timestamp as timestamp, the same value it sends as ltt (indmoney_adapter.py:610-614); the desktop sends that value as ltt and its receipt time as timestamp. Which time a frame's timestamp carries when the broker stamps its packets is a desktop-wide wire question (HDFC Sky has the same): lead decision.

The index packet carries no best bid; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The index packet carries no best bid quantity; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The index packet carries no best ask; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The index packet carries no best ask quantity; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The index packet carries no average traded price; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The index packet carries no open interest; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The index packet carries no OI change; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (web openalgo#2376).

The desktop sends an index's change and change percent, worked out from the previous close, for every broker (feed::bridge::quote_fields), as the web's Kite index frames carry them; this web adapter sends neither.
